emma_sales: Heads up — HelioWorks execs just pushed. POC kickoff blocked by network egress + pricing approval. CISO says no public egress from our hosted endpoint, wants IP allowlist + SOC2 proof. They also flagged a security questionnaire with a couple 'requires legal' items. Can we move fast?
raj_se: On it. quick Q — do they need dedicated GPUs or can we run on hosted with allowlist?
mike_eng: If allowlist is acceptable we can keep them on hosted but need to lock down egress and add origin IPs. For dedicated we'd need a contract change and ~2–3 week lead time.
lisa_security: Sharing SOC2 link and checklist. Ask them to mark data classification. Also we need their encryption-at-rest requirement clarified (customer-managed KMS?).
lisa_security: https://redwood.internal/security/soc2-summary (share externally once CSM confirms)
emma_sales: CSM to confirm whether they require BYO-KMS. Carlos — can you confirm the questionnaire status with HelioWorks?
carlos_csm: Pinged them. They said: "Prefer hosted if we can allowlist and get SOC2 docs today. KMS TBD." They're waiting on pricing commit from us for 3-month pilot (high throughput) before signing the allowlist form.
sarah_revops: Pricing note — pilot at projected QPS pushes into enterprise tier pricing. I can provisional-approve a 20% pilot discount but need VP signoff for anything deeper. Who owns the exec bridge?
emma_sales: I'll own the bridge. Can we get a one-off rate while legal finalizes contract? Need it ASAP for morning call with their CTO. :pray:
raj_se: Technical plan: 1) Provide IP ranges for allowlist 2) Enable restricted hosted endpoint 3) If they insist on no internet egress, escalate to Dedicated.
mike_eng: IP ranges below. Paste into their firewall.
    ```
    34.201.12.0/24
    34.201.13.0/24
    52.23.99.128/25
    ```
emma_sales: Perfect. Carlos, share those with the customer and attach the SOC2 link. Ask whether BYO-KMS is mandatory.
carlos_csm: Sent. Also asked them to complete the top 3 questionnaire items inline.
lisa_security: Two redlines I want to call out: telemetry retention + export controls. If they need custom retention, that'll need a contract addendum.
sarah_revops: Noted. For the pricing ask: provisional 20% for 3 months while we finalize legal. VP @jordan_sales needs a 1-paragraph justification (risk/reason). I can draft if someone gives bullet points.
emma_sales: I'll draft bullets. Main ask: speed to POC to unblock execs; revenue is $XXk ARR potential; prevents competitor proof-of-concept next month.
raj_se: If they want lower latency we can offer a cold-start priority in the hosted pool for the pilot — minor ops change.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: allowlist-restricted-endpoint -> canary -> 1759002200 by @mike_eng
mike_eng: Canary rolling now. Monitoring hooks added.
carlos_csm: HelioWorks confirmed allowlist accepted and SOC2 link received. They want pricing note in email before signing the form.
emma_sales: Great. Sarah — could you send provisional pricing email template? Put legal cc.
sarah_revops: Drafting now, will post here in 15m. VP approval pending — tagging @jordan_sales for visibility.
raj_se: I'll prepare a fallback plan if they later require VPC peering (docs + timeline).
emma_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll run the exec bridge at 10am PT. Agenda: confirm BYO-KMS, finalize provisional pricing, get them to sign allowlist form. :thumbsup:
carlos_csm: Adding meeting notes to the customer folder and will follow up after bridge.
lisa_security: Once they confirm classification and KMS we can clear the questionnaire items.
sarah_revops: Sent provisional pricing to HelioWorks and copied legal. Shared gov doc with VP for signoff.
emma_sales: Closing the loop here — keep updates short in thread. If anything changes before 10am ping me directly. Thanks! :rocket:
